phase: Phase P3 - Analytics Dashboard, Map, WQS, Success Forecast, PWA Testing
summary: HUNTIQ V3 Phase P3 E2E testing complete. All 20 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend pages (Analytics, Map, Forecast) fully functional with all P3 features working correctly. GPT-5.2 AI recommendations operational.

features_tested.notes: KPIs displayed (119 sorties, 48.7% taux succès, 510.8h, 671 observations). Time filters (Semaine/Mois/Saison/Année/Tout) working. Charts (Tendances mensuelles, Répartition par espèce) rendering. Tabs (Vue d'ensemble, Par espèce, Météo, Horaires, Historique) functional.

Leaflet map with OpenStreetMap tiles. 2 waypoints displayed with custom markers. Heatmap toggle working. Add waypoint button present. Waypoint popup shows WQS score (78.8%), classification (Hotspot), visits (69).
CSV and PDF export buttons present on both /analytics and /map pages.
manifest.json accessible with correct HUNTIQ branding. offline.html accessible with French content. Service Worker (sw.js) present in public folder. OfflineIndicator component integrated in App.js.

Success probability displayed (51.3% with high confidence). Species/weather/hour filters working. Best waypoint recommendation shown. WQS ranking with Hotspot badges. Optimal time window (06:00-08:00 ou 17:00-19:00).
/api/v1/waypoint-scoring/recommendations/ai returns personalized hunting advice. /api/v1/waypoint-scoring/briefing returns daily briefing. Both powered by GPT-5.2 with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.
Analytics and Forecast links visible in navbar. Navigation to /analytics and /forecast working correctly.
Returns overview, species_breakdown, weather_analysis, optimal_times, monthly_trends, recent_trips
Returns WQS for all waypoints with scores, classifications, visit counts
Returns lat, lng, intensity, waypoint_id, wqs for heatmap rendering

critical_code_review_comments: All P3 features implemented correctly with proper data-testid attributes
Analytics Dashboard uses Recharts for charts (LineChart, PieChart, BarChart, RadarChart)
Map uses react-leaflet with custom markers and HeatmapLayer component
WQS scoring algorithm uses weighted factors (success_history 40%, weather 25%, activity 20%, accessibility 15%)
GPT-5.2 integration uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY with fallback recommendations
PWA manifest.json properly configured for standalone app
OfflineService handles Service Worker registration and IndexedDB caching
seed_data_creation: Demo data already seeded - 119 hunting trips, 2 waypoints with WQS scores
